screen.m3-frametime.title: SiliconFlow
screen.m3-frametime.profiles.heading: Performance profiles
screen.m3-frametime.profiles.blurb: Choose a preset for mod-owned optimizations. Minecraft video and shader options stay yours.
screen.m3-frametime.profile.playable.des: PLAYABLE: visual-first, safe culling, smooth play.
screen.m3-frametime.profile.shader.desc: SHADER: extra headroom for Iris shader passes.
screen.m3-frametime.profile.max.desc: MAX: strongest trimming for maximum headroom.
screen.m3-frametime.profile.telemetry.de: TELEMETRY: measurement only; no visual trimming.
screen.m3-frametime.profiles.confirm: Two-click confirmation: click a different preset once, then click it again to apply.
screen.m3-frametime.profiles.pending: Pending profile: %s — click the same preset again to apply.
screen.m3-frametime.profiles.footer_hint: Profile changes save to the existing config file; history is not kept across restarts.
screen.m3-frametime.tuning.heading: Tuning
screen.m3-frametime.tuning.blurb: Sliders apply while dragging and save when you release the mouse.
screen.m3-frametime.tuning.shader_hint: SHADER profile: extra GPU headroom for Iris. Shader quality stays in Minecraft/Iris.
screen.m3-frametime.topology.heading: Apple Silicon topology
screen.m3-frametime.topology.blurb: Hardware facts are read-only; macOS retains scheduling and unified-memory authority.
screen.m3-frametime.topology.tier: Active tuning: %s tier · budget scaling on
screen.m3-frametime.topology.pe_unavaila: P/E-core counts: unavailable (macOS scheduling owns placement)
P/E-core topology: unavailable from safe JVM probes
screen.m3-frametime.topology.qos: QoS request: user-owned (scheduler-owned; SiliconFlow does not request QoS)
screen.m3-frametime.topology.gpu_util: GPU utilization: unavailable from the current graphics API
screen.m3-frametime.topology.uma: UMA/VRAM split: unavailable (macOS unified memory; no VRAM measurement)
screen.m3-frametime.diagnostics.heading: Diagnostics
screen.m3-frametime.diagnostics.blurb: Telemetry is opt-in and local. Open F8 for the live overlay.
screen.m3-frametime.diagnostics.heap_uma: Heap vs physical UMA: unhealthy (warning only; -Xmx unchanged)
screen.m3-frametime.diagnostics.sodium_o: Sodium allocator: no warning (SWAP or unread)
screen.m3-frametime.diagnostics.f8_hint: Press F8 for the compact live overlay.
